snippet.title: WARSHIFT 2 - Gameplay Trailer, RTS-Action | Official 4K
snippet.description:
WARSHIFT 2 is a unique mix of Action, RTS and RPG gameplay elements that forms an innovative game genre. You can build base, manage troops, and then come down to keep your enemy at gunpoint in the dynamic battle and customize your main characters.

Available on Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522360/WARSHIFT_2/
Official Site: https://www.warshift2.com/

Game Features:
Create and command your army, construct buildings, and deploy defensive towers.
Seamlessly switch between Third Person Action and Strategy modes in real time on the battlefield.
Experience real-time strategy gameplay with troop management, Aircraft Carriers, and Battleships.
Fight dynamic large-scale battles against massive enemy hordes.
